<!--
  A dark hero band: the head row, a badge, a title with weighted words, the prompt box (or actions) and topic
  pills.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { HeroComposer, HeroNav } from "./hero-prompt.types";
  import type { ActionSet } from "../components/cta-actions.types";
  import type { NavLink } from "./nav-bar.types";
  import type { Topic } from "../components/topic-chips.types";

  export type HeroPromptProps = {
    title: string;
    level?: 1 | 2;
    badge?: string;
    badgeMark?: string;
    actions?: ActionSet;
    composer?: HeroComposer;
    nav?: HeroNav;
    topics?: Topic[];
    density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Container from "../primitives/container/container.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import ActionGroup from "../components/action-group.svelte";
  import HeroBadge from "../components/hero-badge.svelte";
  import HeroHead from "../components/hero-head.svelte";
  import PromptComposer from "../components/prompt-composer.svelte";
  import TopicChips from "../components/topic-chips.svelte";
  import WeightedTitle from "../components/weighted-title.svelte";
  import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    title,
    level = 1,
    badge,
    badgeMark,
    actions,
    composer,
    nav,
    topics,
    density = "roomy",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: HeroPromptProps = $props();
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  class={cn(
    "flex w-full flex-col bg-foreground text-background py-8 [&_.text-muted-foreground]:text-background/70",
    defaults.hero.band
  )}
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : "home-hero-title")}
  data-testid="section"
  data-tone="inverse"
  data-density={density}
  data-chrome="nav"
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
>
  <Container class={cn("mx-auto w-full px-8", defaults.hero.container)} data-slot="container">
    <Stack gap="0" align="stretch">
      <HeroHead
        brand={nav?.brand}
        links={nav?.links}
        current={nav?.current}
        login={nav?.login}
        loginHref={nav?.loginHref}
        skip={nav?.skip}
        navLabel={nav?.label}
        cta={actions?.cta}
        href={actions?.href}
        landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
      />
      <Stack
        gap="0"
        align="center"
        class={cn("mx-auto w-full pt-24 pb-16", defaults.hero.column)}
        data-testid="hero-column"
      >
        {#if badge}
          <HeroBadge label={badge} mark={badgeMark} />
        {/if}
        <WeightedTitle id="home-hero-title" title={title} weights={defaults.hero.titleWeights} level={level} />
        {#if (actions?.mode === "form")}
          <PromptComposer
            label={actions?.emailLabel}
            attachLabel={composer?.attachLabel}
            modelLabel={composer?.modelLabel}
            send={actions?.cta}
            href={actions?.href}
          />
        {:else if actions?.cta}
          <ActionGroup
            primary={actions?.cta}
            primaryHref={actions?.href}
            secondary={((actions?.mode === "two") ? actions?.secondary : undefined)}
            secondaryHref={actions?.secondaryHref}
            align={(true ? "center" : "start")}
          />
        {/if}
        {#if topics}
          <TopicChips topics={topics} tone="inverse" />
        {/if}
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  </Container>
</Block>
